name: Smash Probe
summary: A probe pushed into the scene moves occluding objects out of the way so a fully hidden target can be selected.
howItWorks: Objects in front of the probe are displaced sideways as it advances in depth, uncluttering the region around the target, which is then selected directly.

relationships.note: Both proposed in Yu et al. 2020.
